name: Luna Majogari
source:
A beam of light suddenly falls to the center of the city. Inspector Kaira receives the imperial command to start hunting witches responsible for that. Kaira meets woman Nia - is she also a witch? What's the truth there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一道光束突然落在城市中心。检察官凯拉接到帝国命令，开始追捕对此负责的女巫。凯拉遇见了妮娅——她也是女巫吗？真相究竟是什么？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
